q1_issues.issue: "were up" is re-lexicalized as an invented `rise` event; the instruction set forbids swapping in a single-word synonym for the surface predicate and treats "X is/was ADJ" as a copular clause, so no event should be minted from a copula plus `up` in the first place.

During is used for the surface preposition "in" ("in morning ... trade"), but the instruction set states flatly that During renders only the word "during" and that a near-fit synonym head is never substituted for the preposition actually used.
(Member ge company) asserts a kind the text never states.
(Possession sk_stock_1 ge) reads the bare nominal modifier of "GE stock" as a possessor, but Possession requires an 's, a possessive pronoun, or a genitive of-phrase.
(Location sk_trade_1 new_york_stock_exchange) infers a locative from a bare nominal modifier ("New York Stock Exchange trade") with no preposition in the text to license the role.
(Measure sk_rise_1 price 37 cent) puts a `price` measure on the change event, so a 37-cent DELTA is recorded as if it were a price value; a measured gap has its own form and it is not this.

The resulting price $28.56 is wrapped in Past although it is the value the stock reached and holds at the reported moment; the "to" endpoint is also severed from the change with no relation linking it.

q2_gaps: "be up/down N <unit> to <value>" — a change in a measured value over time, with a delta and a resulting level; Measure, MeasureAtLeast/AtMost, MoreBy and TimesAs all relate entities on a scale and none encodes one entity's value moving by an amount to a new value

a proper-noun nominal modifier on a common noun ("GE stock", "New York Stock Exchange trade") — the compound rules cover common-noun and adjective modifiers and explicitly exclude proper nouns from compounding, but supply no alternative attachment for the proper noun
"in <event-noun> trade" as a temporal/market frame — the licensed obliques (Time, Location, In) and the During relation all mis-describe it
notes: Every head used is a defined operator, so nothing is invented at head level — the defects are misapplied heads (During for "in", Possession for a nominal modifier, Location for a nominal modifier) plus the substitution of `rise` for the surface "were up". The NYSE typing (kind word inside the name) and the day-part Time symbol `morning` are both correct.
